1.name: Acid Armor
1.effect: Raises the user's Defense by 2 stages.

2.name: Acid Spray
2.effect: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.

3.name: Acrobatics
3.effect: Power doubles if the user has no held item.

4.name: Acupressure
4.effect: Raises a random stat by 2 stages as long as the stat is not already at stage 6. The user can choose to use this move on itself or an adjacent ally. Fails if no stat stage can be raised or if used on an ally with a substitute.

5.name: Aerial Ace
5.effect: This move does not check accuracy.

6.name: After You
6.effect: The target makes its move immediately after the user this turn, no matter the priority of its selected move. Fails if the target would have moved next anyway, or if the target already moved this turn.

7.name: Agility
7.effect: Raises the user's Speed by 2 stages.

8.name: Air Cutter
8.effect: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

9.name: Air Slash
9.effect: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

10.name: Alluring Voice
10.effect: Has a 100% chance to confuse the target if it had a stat stage raised this turn.

11.name: Ally Switch
11.effect: The user swaps positions with its ally. Fails if the user is the only Pokemon on its side. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails or if the user's last move used is not Ally Switch.

12.name: Amnesia
12.effect: Raises the user's Special Defense by 2 stages.

13.name: Ancient Power
13.effect: Has a 10% chance to raise the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.

14.name: Apple Acid
14.effect: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

15.name: Aqua Cutter
15.effect: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

17.name: Aqua Ring
17.effect: The user has 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, restored at the end of each turn while it remains active. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down. If the user uses Baton Pass, the replacement will receive the healing effect.

18.name: Aqua Step
18.effect: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.

21.name: Armor Cannon
21.effect: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.

22.name: Aromatic Mist
22.effect: Raises the target's Special Defense by 1 stage. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.

23.name: Assurance
23.effect: Power doubles if the target has already taken damage this turn, other than direct damage from Belly Drum, confusion, Curse, or Pain Split.

24.name: Attract
24.effect: Causes the target to become infatuated, making it unable to attack 50% of the time. Fails if both the user and the target are the same gender, if either is genderless, or if the target is already infatuated. The effect ends when either the user or the target is no longer active. Pokemon with the Oblivious Ability or protected by the Aroma Veil Ability are immune.

25.name: Aura Sphere
25.effect: This move does not check accuracy.

26.name: Aura Wheel
26.effect: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage. If the user is a Morpeko in Full Belly Mode, this move is Electric type. If the user is a Morpeko in Hangry Mode, this move is Dark type. This move cannot be used successfully unless the user's current form, while considering Transform, is Full Belly or Hangry Mode Morpeko.

27.name: Aurora Veil
27.effect: For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5x damage from physical and special attacks, or 0.66x damage if in a Double Battle; does not reduce damage further with Reflect or Light Screen. Critical hits ignore this protection. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Brick Break and Psychic Fangs remove the effect before damage is calculated. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails unless the weather is Snow.

28.name: Avalanche
28.effect: Power doubles if the user was hit by the target this turn.

29.name: Axe Kick
29.effect: Has a 30% chance to confuse the target. If this attack is not successful, the user loses half of its maximum HP, rounded down, as crash damage. Pokemon with the Magic Guard Ability are unaffected by crash damage.

30.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
30.effect: Lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage.

31.name: Baneful Bunker
31.effect: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon making contact with the user become poisoned. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

32.name: Barb Barrage
32.effect: Has a 50% chance to poison the target. Power doubles if the target is already poisoned.

33.name: Baton Pass
33.effect: The user is replaced with another Pokemon in its party. The selected Pokemon has the user's stat stage changes transferred to it, as well as the effects of confusion, Aqua Ring, Curse, Dragon Cheer, Embargo, Focus Energy, Gastro Acid, Heal Block, Ingrain, Leech Seed, Lock-On (Mind Reader), Magnet Rise, Perish Song, Power Trick, Telekinesis, and a substitute with its remaining HP. The effect of Gastro Acid is not transferred if the recipient has an Ability that cannot be affected.

34.name: Beak Blast
34.effect: If the user is hit by a contact move this turn before it can execute this move, the attacker is burned.

35.name: Beat Up
35.effect: Hits one time for the user and one time for each unfainted Pokemon without a non-volatile status condition in the user's party. The power of each hit is equal to 5+(X/10), where X is each participating Pokemon's base Attack; each hit is considered to come from the user.

36.name: Belch
36.effect: This move cannot be selected until the user eats a Berry, either by eating one that was held, stealing and eating one off another Pokemon with Bug Bite or Pluck, or eating one that was thrown at it with Fling. Once the condition is met, this move can be selected and used for the rest of the battle even if the user gains or uses another item or switches out. Consuming a Berry with Natural Gift does not count for the purposes of eating one.

37.name: Belly Drum
37.effect: Raises the user's Attack by 12 stages in exchange for the user losing 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down. Fails if the user would faint or if its Attack stat stage is 6.

38.name: Bind
38.effect: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

39.name: Bite
39.effect: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

40.name: Bitter Blade
40.effect: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.

41.name: Bitter Malice
41.effect: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.

42.name: Blast Burn
42.effect: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.

43.name: Blaze Kick
43.effect: Has a 10% chance to burn the target and a higher chance for a critical hit.

44.name: Blizzard
44.effect: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target. If the weather is Snow, this move does not check accuracy.

45.name: Block
45.effect: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.

46.name: Body Press
46.effect: Damage is calculated using the user's Defense stat as its Attack, including stat stage changes. Other effects that modify the Attack stat are used as normal.

47.name: Body Slam
47.effect: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

48.name: Bone Rush
48.effect: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

50.name: Bounce
50.effect: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, Thunder, and Twister, and Gust and Twister have doubled power when used against it. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

51.name: Brave Bird
51.effect: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

52.name: Breaking Swipe
52.effect: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.

53.name: Brick Break
53.effect: If this attack does not miss, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil end for the target's side of the field before damage is calculated.

55.name: Bug Bite
55.effect: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held Berry if it is holding one and eats it immediately, gaining its effects even if the user's item is being ignored. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

56.name: Bug Buzz
56.effect: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

57.name: Bulk Up
57.effect: Raises the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.

58.name: Bulldoze
58.effect: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

60.name: Bullet Seed
60.effect: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

61.name: Burn Up
61.effect: Fails unless the user is a Fire type. If this move is successful and the user is not Terastallized, the user's Fire type becomes typeless as long as it remains active.

62.name: Burning Jealousy
62.effect: Has a 100% chance to burn the target if it had a stat stage raised this turn.

63.name: Calm Mind
63.effect: Raises the user's Special Attack and Special Defense by 1 stage.

64.name: Ceaseless Edge
64.effect: If this move is successful, it sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. A maximum of three layers may be set, and opponents lose 1/8 of their maximum HP with one layer, 1/6 of their maximum HP with two layers, and 1/4 of their maximum HP with three layers, all rounded down. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.

65.name: Charge
65.effect: Raises the user's Special Defense by 1 stage. The user's next Electric-type attack will have its power doubled; the effect ends when the user is no longer active, or after the user attempts to use any Electric-type move besides Charge, even if it is not successful.

66.name: Charge Beam
66.effect: Has a 70% chance to raise the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.

67.name: Charm
67.effect: Lowers the target's Attack by 2 stages.

68.name: Chilling Water
68.effect: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.

69.name: Chilly Reception
69.effect: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Snow. The user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members.

70.name: Circle Throw
70.effect: If both the user and the target have not fainted, the target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. This effect fails if the target is under the effect of Ingrain, has the Suction Cups Ability, or this move hit a substitute.

71.name: Clanging Scales
71.effect: Lowers the user's Defense by 1 stage.

72.name: Clangorous Soul
72.effect: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage in exchange for the user losing 33% of its maximum HP, rounded down. Fails if the user would faint or if its Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed stat stages would not change.

73.name: Clear Smog
73.effect: Resets all of the target's stat stages to 0.

74.name: Close Combat
74.effect: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.

75.name: Coaching
75.effect: Raises the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.

76.name: Coil
76.effect: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, and accuracy by 1 stage.

77.name: Comeuppance
77.effect: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a physical or special attack this turn equal to 1.5 times the HP lost by the user from that attack, rounded down. If the user did not lose HP from that attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's physical or special attack this turn.

79.name: Confuse Ray
79.effect: Causes the target to become confused.

80.name: Copycat
80.effect: The user uses the last move used by any Pokemon, including itself. Fails if no move has been used, or if the last move used was Assist, Baneful Bunker, Beak Blast, Behemoth Bash, Behemoth Blade, Belch, Bestow, Blazing Torque, Celebrate, Chatter, Circle Throw, Combat Torque, Copycat, Counter, Covet, Destiny Bond, Detect, Dragon Tail, Dynamax Cannon, Endure, Feint, Focus Punch, Follow Me, Helping Hand, Hold Hands, King's Shield, Magical Torque, Mat Block, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Protect, Rage Powder, Roar, Shell Trap, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Spiky Shield, Spotlight, Struggle, Switcheroo, Tera Starstorm, Thief, Transform, Trick, Whirlwind, or Wicked Torque.

81.name: Corrosive Gas
81.effect: The target loses its held item. This move cannot cause Pokemon with the Sticky Hold Ability to lose their held item or cause a Kyogre, a Groudon, a Giratina, an Arceus, a Genesect, a Silvally, a Zacian, or a Zamazenta to lose their Blue Orb, Red Orb, Griseous Orb, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, or Rusted Shield respectively. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

82.name: Cosmic Power
82.effect: Raises the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.

83.name: Cotton Guard
83.effect: Raises the user's Defense by 3 stages.

84.name: Cotton Spore
84.effect: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages.

85.name: Counter
85.effect: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a physical attack this turn equal to twice the HP lost by the user from that attack. If the user did not lose HP from the attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's physical attack this turn.

523.name: Court Change
523.effect: Switches the Mist, Light Screen, Reflect, Spikes, Safeguard, Tailwind, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, Water Pledge, Fire Pledge, Grass Pledge, Sticky Web, Aurora Veil, G-Max Steelsurge, G-Max Cannonade, G-Max Vine Lash, and G-Max Wildfire effects from the user's side to the opposing side and vice versa.

86.name: Covet
86.effect: If this attack was successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held item if the user is not holding one. The target's item is not stolen if it is a Mail or Z-Crystal, or if the target is a Kyogre holding a Blue Orb, a Groudon holding a Red Orb, a Giratina holding a Griseous Orb, an Arceus holding a Plate, a Genesect holding a Drive, a Silvally holding a Memory, or a Pokemon that can Mega Evolve holding the Mega Stone for its species. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

87.name: Crabhammer
87.effect: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

88.name: Cross Chop
88.effect: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

89.name: Cross Poison
89.effect: Has a 10% chance to poison the target and a higher chance for a critical hit.

90.name: Crunch
90.effect: Has a 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.

91.name: Crush Claw
91.effect: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.

92.name: Curse
92.effect: If the user is not a Ghost type, lowers the user's Speed by 1 stage and raises the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. If the user is a Ghost type, the user loses 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down and even if it would cause fainting, in exchange for the target losing 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn while it is active. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will continue to be affected. Fails if there is no target or if the target is already affected.

93.name: Dark Pulse
93.effect: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.

94.name: Darkest Lariat
94.effect: Ignores the target's stat stage changes, including evasiveness.

96.name: Decorate
96.effect: Raises the target's Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages.

97.name: Defog
97.effect: Lowers the target's evasiveness by 1 stage. If this move is successful and whether or not the target's evasiveness was affected, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Safeguard, Mist, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Sticky Web end for the target's side, and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Sticky Web end for the user's side. Ignores a target's substitute, although a substitute will still block the lowering of evasiveness. If there is a terrain active and this move is successful, the terrain will be cleared.

98.name: Destiny Bond
98.effect: Until the user's next move, if an opposing Pokemon's attack knocks the user out, that Pokemon faints as well, unless the attack was Doom Desire or Future Sight. Fails if the user used this move successfully as its last move, disregarding moves used through the Dancer Ability.

99.name: Detect
99.effect: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

100.name: Dig
100.effect: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Earthquake and Magnitude but takes double damage from them, and is also unaffected by weather. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

101.name: Dire Claw
101.effect: Has a 30% chance to cause the target to either fall asleep, become poisoned, or become paralyzed.

102.name: Disable
102.effect: For 4 turns, the target's last move used becomes disabled. Fails if one of the target's moves is already disabled, if the target has not made a move, if the target no longer knows the move, or if the move was a Max or G-Max Move.

103.name: Discharge
103.effect: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.

104.name: Dive
104.effect: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Surf and Whirlpool but takes double damage from them, and is also unaffected by weather. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

105.name: Double-Edge
105.effect: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

106.name: Double Hit
106.effect: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

107.name: Double Shock
107.effect: Fails unless the user is an Electric type. If this move is successful and the user is not Terastallized, the user's Electric type becomes typeless as long as it remains active.

108.name: Double Team
108.effect: Raises the user's evasiveness by 1 stage.

109.name: Draco Meteor
109.effect: Lowers the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.

110.name: Dragon Cheer
110.effect: Raises the target's chance for a critical hit by 1 stage, or by 2 stages if the target is Dragon type. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user, or if the target already has this effect or the Focus Energy effect. Baton Pass can be used to transfer this effect to an ally.

112.name: Dragon Dance
112.effect: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by 1 stage.

113.name: Dragon Darts
113.effect: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit. In Double Battles, this move attempts to hit the targeted Pokemon and its ally once each. If hitting one of these Pokemon would be prevented by immunity, protection, semi-invulnerability, an Ability, or accuracy, it attempts to hit the other Pokemon twice instead. If this move is redirected, it hits that target twice.

115.name: Dragon Rush
115.effect: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

116.name: Dragon Tail
116.effect: If both the user and the target have not fainted, the target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. This effect fails if the target used Ingrain previously, has the Suction Cups Ability, or this move hit a substitute.

117.name: Drain Punch
117.effect: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.

118.name: Draining Kiss
118.effect: The user recovers 3/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.

120.name: Drill Run
120.effect: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

524.name: Drum Beating
524.effect: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

121.name: Dual Wingbeat
121.effect: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

122.name: Dynamic Punch
122.effect: Has a 100% chance to confuse the target.

123.name: Earth Power
123.effect: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

124.name: Earthquake
124.effect: Damage doubles if the target is using Dig.

126.name: Eerie Impulse
126.effect: Lowers the target's Special Attack by 2 stages.

127.name: Eerie Spell
127.effect: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the target loses 3 PP from its last move.

128.name: Electric Terrain
128.effect: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Electric Terrain. During the effect, the power of Electric-type attacks made by grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 1.3 and grounded Pokemon cannot fall asleep; Pokemon already asleep do not wake up. Grounded Pokemon cannot become affected by Yawn or fall asleep from its effect. Camouflage transforms the user into an Electric type, Nature Power becomes Thunderbolt, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to cause paralysis. Fails if the current terrain is Electric Terrain.

129.name: Electrify
129.effect: Causes the target's move to become Electric type this turn. Among effects that can change a move's type, this effect happens last. Fails if the target already moved this turn.

130.name: Electro Ball
130.effect: The power of this move depends on (user's current Speed / target's current Speed), rounded down. Power is equal to 150 if the result is 4 or more, 120 if 3, 80 if 2, 60 if 1, 40 if less than 1. If the target's current Speed is 0, this move's power is 40.

131.name: Electro Shot
131.effect: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Raises the user's Special Attack by 1 stage on the first turn. If the user is holding a Power Herb or the weather is Primordial Sea or Rain Dance, the move completes in one turn. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and the weather is Primordial Sea or Rain Dance, the move still requires a turn to charge.

132.name: Electroweb
132.effect: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

134.name: Encore
134.effect: For its next 3 turns, the target is forced to repeat its last move used. If the affected move runs out of PP, the effect ends. Fails if the target is already under this effect, if it has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, or if the move is Assist, Blazing Torque, Combat Torque, Copycat, Dynamax Cannon, Encore, Magical Torque, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Transform, or Wicked Torque.

135.name: Endeavor
135.effect: Deals damage to the target equal to (target's current HP - user's current HP). The target is unaffected if its current HP is less than or equal to the user's current HP.

136.name: Endure
136.effect: The user will survive attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn with at least 1 HP. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

137.name: Energy Ball
137.effect: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

138.name: Entrainment
138.effect: Causes the target's Ability to become the same as the user's. Fails if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Truant, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero, or the same Ability as the user, or if the user's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

139.name: Eruption
139.effect: Power is equal to (user's current HP * 150 / user's maximum HP), rounded down, but not less than 1.

140.name: Expanding Force
140.effect: If the current terrain is Psychic Terrain and the user is grounded, this move hits all opposing Pokemon and has its power multiplied by 1.5.

141.name: Explosion
141.effect: The user faints after using this move, even if this move fails for having no target. This move is prevented from executing if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability.

142.name: Extrasensory
142.effect: Has a 10% chance to make the target flinch.

144.name: Facade
144.effect: Power doubles if the user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned. The physical damage halving effect from the user's burn is ignored.

145.name: Fairy Lock
145.effect: Prevents all active Pokemon from switching next turn. A Pokemon can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. Fails if the effect is already active.

146.name: Fake Out
146.effect: Has a 100% chance to make the target flinch. Fails unless it is the user's first turn on the field.

147.name: Fake Tears
